# Encode URL

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Encodes the given text in URL allowed characters.

## Syntax

~~~~text
encodeURL(url: <#String (Allows Variables)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
encodeURL(url: "https://jellycuts.com")
~~~~
